headline: HR Assistant

notes: Thesis: Job satisfaction among rice terrace tourism workers

summary: Psychology graduate and licensed psychometrician working as an HR assistant for a regional hotel group. I coordinate recruitment from job posting to onboarding, keep employee records and HR forms in order, and schedule interviews and trainings. I want to grow into a full HR generalist role.

projects.name: Onboarding checklist for seasonal staff
projects.description: Wrote a one-page onboarding checklist and welcome kit for peak-season hires, which cut missing requirements on day one.

skills: HR processes: onboarding, 201 files, leave forms

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Post openings on job boards and the local PESO board, screen about 60 applications a month and set up interviews.
Administer and score pre-employment tests with the HR officer.
Prepare onboarding kits and keep complete 201 files for 140 employees across three properties.
Manage the HR calendar of interviews, orientations and training sessions.

experience.title: HR Intern
bullets: Updated member-employee records and helped organise a hiring event for tour guides.
